request.meaning: Create a query plan; repeated requests return the saved run.

resume.meaning: Preserve queries/results and clear the previous worker and interruption.

claim.meaning: Claim or renew an active run; requested becomes discovering.

progress.meaning: Update the candidate query plan and phase atomically. Existing workerless execution remains supported.

verify.meaning: Begin shortlist verification after category coverage.

complete.meaning: Complete coverage, independently of listing evidence and buying outcome.

interrupt.meaning: Save partial progress or explain an interruption.

import.meaning: Save observations and run keys in the same transaction; failed guards roll back the batch.

cancel.meaning: Stop execution without discarding results. Repeated cancellation is harmless.

expire.meaning: Expired execution becomes partial with results, otherwise blocked. Reads project this without writing.

defer.meaning: Stop scheduled execution when eligibility changes.

fulfil.meaning: A recorded purchase fences linked buying goals and their runs.

inspect.meaning: Read progress and available actions without advancing a run.

run_stopped.message: This search is stopped. Start or resume a run first.
run_stopped.recovery: Read the run and resume with a new worker before worker activity.

run_finished.message: This run has finished and stopped. Start a new run.
run_finished.recovery: Read saved results or request a new run.

revision_conflict.message: Search progress changed. Read the run before updating or claiming it.
revision_conflict.recovery: Use the returned run version for progress updates and new claims.

search_changed.message: The buying brief changed. Start a new search run.
search_changed.recovery: Read the saved search and request a run for its current brief.

goal_fulfilled.recovery: Reopen the purchased conversation before searching again.

scheduled_ineligible.message: Scheduled execution is not currently eligible.

worker_required.message: Claim this search before reporting activity.
worker_required.recovery: Claim with the actual spawned agent identity and current version.

worker_mismatch.message: This background search is owned by another agent or has stopped. Read the run before continuing.
worker_mismatch.recovery: Use the current worker_id, unexpired lease and unchanged search brief.

lease_expired.recovery: Read the run, resolve the interruption and resume with a new worker.

execution_input.message: Supply the proposed progress or observation evidence.
execution_input.recovery: Use original query identities and a stable request_id for each import batch.

request_input.message: Supply a search request and fresh request_id.
request_input.recovery: Use the saved search_id, a fresh request_id and the intended manual or scheduled trigger.

claim_input.message: Supply the real spawned agent_id and worker_id.
claim_input.recovery: The parent cannot claim for the worker; pass the spawned agent's identity.

category_query_unchecked.message: Check a broad category query before shortlist verification.
category_query_unchecked.recovery: Complete a broad category query; query and phase may be updated together.

query_coverage_incomplete.message: Complete a broad category query and account for remaining queries, or mark this run partial.
query_coverage_incomplete.recovery: Complete queries or skip them with reasons. Failed queries require recovery or a partial run.

interruption_required.recovery: Provide an interruption when marking a run blocked.

transition_invalid.message: This event does not allow that search phase.
transition_invalid.recovery: Read the run's action descriptors and choose an applicable event.

requested.meaning: A durable query plan awaits execution.
requested.invariant: Saved results and query identities survive reconnects.
requested.recovery: Claim with the actual spawned agent_id, a new worker_id and current run version.

discovering.invariant: A worker, when present, owns an unexpired lease.
discovering.recovery: Import discoveries in batches and report query coverage.

verifying.meaning: The broad category has been checked; shortlist evidence is being collected.
verifying.invariant: At least one broad category query is completed.
verifying.recovery: Record gallery reviews separately from saved media.

partial.meaning: Execution stopped with saved results or incomplete coverage.
partial.invariant: Completion is not claimed; saved evidence remains available.
partial.recovery: Resume with a new real background agent after resolving the interruption.

completed.invariant: A category query is completed and no query is planned, running or failed. This does not prove listing verification or a purchase.
completed.recovery: Read saved listings and buying next steps, or request a new run.

blocked.recovery: Resolve the interruption, then resume with a new worker.

cancelled.meaning: The run was stopped deliberately or its buying goal was fulfilled.
cancelled.invariant: Results remain saved; this run accepts no further progress or imports.
cancelled.recovery: Request a new run for an unfulfilled buying goal.

deferred.meaning: Scheduled execution waits for eligibility or active hours.
deferred.invariant: Monitoring preference and observed host schedule remain separate from run phase.

save_draft.meaning: Save reviewed wording without creating an execution action.

collection_plan.meaning: Persist collection terms and their confirmation evidence, separately from buying outcome.

arrange.meaning: Prepare wording from the saved plan and unresolved questions.

request_send.meaning: Record the exact reviewed draft. Authorization remains the caller's responsibility; this grants no permit.

handoff.meaning: Record host acceptance; subsequent reports are harmless.

cancel.meaning: Cancel only before a possible send.

claim.meaning: Claim execution or reconciliation. Claiming never grants a send permit.

permit.meaning: Issue one permit after exact identity and draft checks, or pause before sending if facts changed.

result.meaning: Record observed results; terminal confirmations are idempotent. Uncertain results require reconciliation.

outcome.meaning: Record open/bought/withdrawn/unavailable independently of conversation phase. Only bought fulfils a buying goal.

inspect.meaning: Read conversation phase, buying outcome and execution guidance. Existing expired actions are reconciled by the server.

expire.meaning: An expired send becomes uncertain; an expired check becomes blocked.

conversation_changed.message: Conversation changed elsewhere. Refresh it before editing or sending.
conversation_changed.recovery: Read the conversation and use its current version.

conversation_closed.message: Reopen the conversation before another action.
conversation_closed.recovery: Record an open buying outcome before new outreach.

pending_action.message: An action already exists. Continue or reconcile the pending send or check before requesting another.
pending_action.recovery: Resolve or cancel the pending action before creating more work.

pending_send.message: Resolve or cancel the pending send before changing its draft.
pending_send.recovery: Keep the approved draft and collection terms immutable during a send.

draft_missing.message: Save and review a message first.
draft_missing.recovery: Save the exact reviewed wording before requesting a send.

collection_expired.message: Update the expired collection time before sending.
collection_expired.recovery: Update collection terms and obtain review of the new draft.

availability_unchecked.message: Recheck availability before contacting this seller.
availability_unchecked.recovery: Observe an active listing before requesting a send permit.

reply_unreviewed.message: The latest seller reply needs review first.
reply_unreviewed.recovery: Review the latest reply and bind the draft's responds_to to it.

contact_unverified.message: Check this listing's message interface before preparing outreach. Native offers use the platform offer interface.
contact_unverified.recovery: Observe this listing's contact options in the current browser context.

marketplace_disabled.message: This marketplace is disabled in Settings.
marketplace_disabled.recovery: Enable the selected marketplace before browser execution.

manual_only.message: This marketplace currently supports copy/open and manual history.
manual_only.recovery: Use manual history for sample and unsupported marketplaces.

browser_unverified.message: Check browser access in Settings before this action.
browser_unverified.recovery: Observe fresh browser access in this server context.

signin_unverified.message: Facebook messaging requires verified sign-in in this browser profile.
signin_unverified.recovery: Verify sign-in in the saved buyer, host and browser profile.

executor_active.message: This action already has an active executor.
executor_active.recovery: Wait for the current executor or reconcile after its lease expires.

lease_expired.message: Execution lease expired. Claim and reconcile the conversation before continuing.
lease_expired.recovery: Claim a current lease token; reconcile an interrupted send before repeating anything.

lease_input.recovery: Use the token from the current claim, never a previous executor's token.

permit_already_issued.message: This action cannot issue another send permit; reconcile the thread first.
permit_already_issued.recovery: Send only after prepare returns a fresh execution.send_permitted true; never reuse or request a second permit.

sample_only.message: Sample conversations support manual practice only; no browser action is permitted
sample_only.recovery: Use manual history in sample mode.

listing_identity.message: The observed listing does not match the approved item
listing_identity.recovery: Return to the approved canonical item URL and listing ID.

seller_identity.message: The seller does not match this listing
seller_identity.recovery: Verify the seller attached to the approved listing.

profile_mismatch.message: Verify sign-in in the chosen browser profile before this action
profile_mismatch.recovery: Verify buyer sign-in and contact observations in the same host and profile.

identity_unverified.message: Verify the seller and thread before confirming.
identity_unverified.recovery: Verify listing, seller, buyer, host, profile and thread identity.

identity_mismatch.message: Verify the existing seller, buyer and conversation in the same browser profile.
identity_mismatch.recovery: Return to the approved listing and established seller thread.

evidence_required.message: Confirm the exact outgoing message in the verified thread.
evidence_required.recovery: Report observed evidence and exact text; classification needs supporting seller words.

action_unclaimed.recovery: Claim a browser or reconciliation lease before reporting the result.

uncertain_send.message: Verify an interrupted send before cancelling it; a potentially sent message must remain uncertain until reconciled.
uncertain_send.recovery: Inspect the verified thread; do not resend or cancel an uncertain send.

executor_input.recovery: Use the actual browser executor's identity.

review_required.message: Sending requires explicit authorization of the exact reviewed text.
review_required.recovery: Obtain user review of the saved wording. Request records that wording; the server cannot infer user authorization from state.

input_required.recovery: Read the operation schema and supply its required inputs.

awaiting_handoff.meaning: An immutable reviewed action is saved for host handoff.
awaiting_handoff.invariant: The draft is bound to this action; no send permission exists.
awaiting_handoff.recovery: Report host acceptance or cancel before execution.

requested.meaning: Host accepted the action; browser execution is pending.
requested.invariant: Handoff does not prove a message was sent.
requested.recovery: Verify browser access and sign-in, then claim.

running.meaning: An executor holds a lease and must verify the thread.
running.invariant: Claiming never grants permission to send.
running.recovery: For send, request one permit; for check, report observed replies.

ready_to_send.meaning: A single-use permit was issued for exact text and identity.
ready_to_send.invariant: No second permit may be issued. A workflow descriptor never grants permission.
ready_to_send.recovery: Report evidence from the verified thread. Reconcile after interruption.

sent.meaning: The exact outgoing message was observed or reported by the user.
sent.invariant: Provenance distinguishes browser evidence from user reports.
sent.recovery: Check replies or prepare a new reviewed action.

checked.meaning: A verified thread was inspected for replies.
checked.invariant: Message identity and classification evidence are preserved.
checked.recovery: Review new replies before further outreach.

not_sent.meaning: The stopped action has evidence that no outgoing message was sent.
not_sent.invariant: A send requires verified thread identity to record this result.
not_sent.recovery: Prepare a new reviewed action if still wanted.

uncertain.meaning: An interrupted send might have reached the seller.
uncertain.invariant: It cannot be resent, cancelled or granted another permit.
uncertain.recovery: Claim a reconciliation lease and inspect the same thread.

blocked.meaning: Execution stopped before a potential send, or a check lease expired.
blocked.invariant: Potentially sent messages remain uncertain instead.
blocked.recovery: Resolve the blocker, cancel or claim again.

cancelled.meaning: The action was cancelled before sending.
cancelled.invariant: Cancellation cannot erase an uncertain send.
cancelled.recovery: Prepare a new action if needed.

renew_goodfinds_connection_check.name: renew_goodfinds_connection_check

complete_goodfinds_connection_check.name: complete_goodfinds_connection_check
complete_goodfinds_connection_check.description: The claimed subagent saves paired observed browser-access and sign-in evidence for the selected routes using its worker_id and current version. Verify actual host/browser/profile identity; public access does not prove sign-in. Unsupported targets may be omitted and remain unknown. Do not use standalone access/session reporting tools to bypass this job's cancellation and ownership checks.

interrupt_goodfinds_connection_check.name: interrupt_goodfinds_connection_check
interrupt_goodfinds_connection_check.description: Record the actual delegation/browser limitation or failure. The parent may stop an unclaimed queued check; a running check requires the owning worker_id. Use unavailable for missing delegation or browser capability. Preserve previous account evidence and selected routes; do not perform a foreground fallback.

cancel_goodfinds_connection_check.name: cancel_goodfinds_connection_check
cancel_goodfinds_connection_check.description: Cancel a queued or running connection check. The worker must stop at its next status/lease check and close only its own tabs. Further result writes are rejected. Does not sign out, change permissions or discard previous evidence.

get_goodfinds_setup_context.name: get_goodfinds_setup_context
get_goodfinds_setup_context.description: Read setup in one compact call: settings and scoped revision tokens, saved search/draft names for reuse, and a template catalog. Pass category for its starter definition. Read regional_context before asking questions: explicit preferences override saved preferences, then optional client locale/country hints. Templates use the resolved currency; unresolved currency returns no template. Preserve explicit currency symbols/codes and save regional_context country/locale/fulfilment in search.market. Use returned regional marketplace URLs. Accept the buyer's stated city or area and update an older origin directly. A complete brief saves directly with save_goodfinds_search; new searches default to recurring checks every two hours unless saved timing or an explicit one-off choice applies. Host scheduling must still be verified. Read get_goodfinds_search_context with search_id only when resuming an existing brief.

preferences.description: Explicit regional choices for this brief; omitted fields use saved preferences and locale hints.

Unlinked searches still need host schedule discovery through the marketplace-shopping scheduling guidance.

Use shortlisted: true to return bookmarked listings, scoped to search_id when supplied. Disregarded listings are hidden unless include_dismissed is true. Excluded models and aliases are hidden even in all results unless include_excluded is true. Use seen: unseen or seen to filter buyer reading status independently for each search; reading this tool never clears unseen status. Filtering precedes pagination; stale/unknown seller counts cannot satisfy a hard filter. Sort recent (last checked), recommended, price_low/price_high within currency/rent-period groups, or found_newest/found_oldest (first found, unchanged by rechecks). Returns compact specifications, seller context, match reasons and saved media counts; read get_goodfinds_listing for complete evidence/history.

save_goodfinds_search.description: Create or edit a search using its validated definition and answers. Apply the search-name rules in references/search-setup.md. Every stated must-have needs a matching definition field and values answer; description text and comparison_attributes alone do not filter listings. Item state (used/new/refurbished) is separate from condition grade. A complete brief can be saved directly without a draft. New searches save recurring monitoring at the saved cadence, defaulting to two hours. Pass initial_monitoring with preference once for an explicit one-off request, or recurring with custom timing. Edits preserve the existing monitoring preference. Use expected_entity_revision = revisions.absent for a new search, or revisions.searches[search.id] for an edit. To promote a draft, also pass draft_id and expected_draft_revision = revisions.drafts[draft_id]; the entity token still belongs to the destination search. Never use the top-level workspace revision. Keep explicit no-budget answers null with the price field required:false; never invent a ceiling. For a direct search request, call start_goodfinds_search after this save to display progress immediately. Resolve cover_follow_up at the start of collection, before marketplace discovery: choose an accepted model or clearly labelled representative family photo, cache and attach it, or report the concrete blocker. Follow references/search-covers.md. Then resolve returned monitoring.next_action through the skill's evaluation-delivery guide; saving alone does not schedule checks. Increment definition.version when fields change. Prices are integer pence.

prepare_goodfinds_collection_message.name: prepare_goodfinds_collection_message

get_goodfinds_seller_conversation.name: get_goodfinds_seller_conversation

save_goodfinds_seller_message_draft.name: save_goodfinds_seller_message_draft
save_goodfinds_seller_message_draft.description: Save the buyer's exact message, offer and optional collection terms with the current conversation version. Saving does not authorize sending. A reply must reference the incoming message it answers.

request_goodfinds_seller_action.name: request_goodfinds_seller_action
request_goodfinds_seller_action.description: Create one durable send or check action with a unique request_id. Request a send only when the user explicitly chooses the exact reviewed text and listing, after report_goodfinds_listing_contact confirms its message interface. Native platform offers use their separate form handoff. Reuse the action ID when retrying a handoff. This records authorization; it does not send a platform message. Sample mode is manual practice only.

report_goodfinds_seller_action_handoff.name: report_goodfinds_seller_action_handoff
report_goodfinds_seller_action_handoff.description: Record that the host accepted this action request. This is not confirmation of a seller message.

cancel_goodfinds_seller_action.name: cancel_goodfinds_seller_action
cancel_goodfinds_seller_action.description: Cancel an unstarted or safely blocked action. An interrupted or potentially sent message requires thread reconciliation first.

claim_goodfinds_seller_action.name: claim_goodfinds_seller_action
claim_goodfinds_seller_action.description: Claim a saved user-approved action after current browser access and profile sign-in are reported. Returns a lease_token and reconcile_required; never grants send permission. Completed actions return no lease. An interrupted send can only be reconciled, not resent. Follow references/seller-conversation.md.

issue_goodfinds_message_send_permit.name: issue_goodfinds_message_send_permit
issue_goodfinds_message_send_permit.description: Immediately before sending, verify canonical listing, seller profile, buyer, browser profile and existing thread, and check the thread for duplicates. Supply actual identity evidence. Returns execution.send_permitted true at most once per action after checking collection expiry and availability. Send only on that fresh true result; replay cannot grant another permit.

report_goodfinds_seller_action_result.name: report_goodfinds_seller_action_result
report_goodfinds_seller_action_result.description: Record sent only after observing the exact outgoing draft in its verified thread; include its full text in evidence. An interrupted send stays uncertain until reconciliation proves sent or not_sent. Checked imports incoming messages in chronological order, with stable external_id, actual platform_at or null, multiple reply facets and supporting words. No new reply is not rejection. This tool records evidence; it performs no browser action.

record_goodfinds_user_reported_message.name: record_goodfinds_user_reported_message
record_goodfinds_user_reported_message.description: Record a seller reply or the exact pending outgoing message explicitly reported sent by the user. Provenance stays user_reported; do not claim a browser observation. Use a stable external_id and current conversation version.

correct_goodfinds_reply_interpretation.name: correct_goodfinds_reply_interpretation
correct_goodfinds_reply_interpretation.description: Record the buyer's correction to one seller message, retaining the original facets in an audit event. Multiple price, collection and availability facets can coexist; uncertain wording needs review.

set_goodfinds_buying_outcome.name: set_goodfinds_buying_outcome
set_goodfinds_buying_outcome.description: Record open, bought, withdrawn or unavailable as stated by the user. An accepted offer is not a purchase. Listing asking price and availability observations stay unchanged.

report_goodfinds_marketplace_session.name: report_goodfinds_marketplace_session
report_goodfinds_marketplace_session.description: Record sign-in observed in one marketplace and browser profile. Use actual visible evidence, current context_id and revision. Public browsing is not sign-in. Keep passwords, cookies and API credentials in their own stores.

list_goodfinds_marketplace_capabilities.description: Read existing marketplace capabilities. Pass country and locale from setup/search context for regional homepages; null home means no supported regional route. Browse with the selected host browser and verify listing delivery and sign-in separately.

load_goodfinds_sample_workspace.description: Load explicitly fictional Marketplace listings in an isolated sample workspace. Repeating the sample evaluation exercises suppression of unchanged alert previews. Does not search Facebook.

import_goodfinds_listing_observations.description: Save and evaluate supplied or browser-inspected listing observations using the marketplace-shopping skill's listing-evidence and observations references. Use canonical marketplace listing IDs/URLs, provenance manual, source excerpts and recorded observation times. Import discovery cards provisionally; verification needs inspected gallery images and seller videos, separate complete review records, and cached media IDs. Unknown facts remain unknown. Compare full outright asking prices, excluding finance, bids and deposits. Optional search_coverage records query scope, pagination and success/partial/failed evidence; missing listings never prove a sale. Worker imports include run_id and worker_id. Use a fresh request_id per batch and retry the same ID and arguments after an ambiguous response. The host agent performs browsing; this tool persists and evaluates its evidence.

Use for missing-media reconciliation; keeps independent durable capture receipts across later collector refreshes. Complete requires every observed file. Partial/unavailable preserves existing files. Failures stay partial, never invent media or treat a poster as a reviewed video.

get_goodfinds_media_file.description: Resolve a saved listing photo or seller video to its verified local file, MIME type and size, without putting video bytes into the conversation. Use gallery IDs from get_goodfinds_listing. Local hosts can preview this file; hosts without local-file access can play it in the connected Goodfinds panel. Supports only managed cached media IDs; never accepts an arbitrary path or fetches a URL.

get_goodfinds_image.name: get_goodfinds_image
get_goodfinds_image.description: View one saved product, search or seller image by its media ID, in chat or the panel. Use IDs returned by get_goodfinds_listing or search context. The image alone does not establish inspection of the whole gallery.

get_goodfinds_video.name: get_goodfinds_video
get_goodfinds_video.description: Read a cached MP4 or WebM by media ID on demand. Video bytes stay separate from listing state.

list_goodfinds_pending_alerts.description: Read a stable page of pending alerts after a restart or completed search. Reading does not acknowledge delivery. Present current evidence through the authorized host channel before acknowledging these IDs.
